messages:
feat: apply JSON Patches to a JSON document (RFC 6902)

Add `applyPatch(document, patch)`, implementing the six operations of
RFC 6902 § 4 with the equality of § 4.6 and the all-or-nothing rule of
§ 5. The document is deep-copied once, the operations change the copy,
and it is returned only if every one of them succeeds, so the input is
never touched and a failing patch changes nothing.

Failures throw `JsonPatchError`, whose `reason` separates a patch that
is wrong whatever the document (`invalid-patch`) from one that does not
fit this document (`operation-failed`) and from a `test` that did not
hold (`test-failed`).

The pointer module now shares its internals -- `parsePointer`,
`resolveTokens`, `arrayIndex`, `formatPointer`, `describeLocation` --
and the helpers that render values in error messages move to the new
`src/message.ts`, so both features speak the same vocabulary. Behaviour
of `resolvePointer` is unchanged.
